application.description: Builds the Lynx bundle with rspeedy (--watch to rebuild on changes) and, with --platform, the iOS and Android binaries

dev-server.description: Runs the rspeedy dev server for Lynx Explorer and the web preview

unit-test.description: Runs the unit tests with Angular's unit-test builder, set up for AngularLynx

extract-i18n.description: Extracts the i18n messages with Angular's extract-i18n builder, set up for AngularLynx
